title: Rogers Corporation Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call for October 27
summary: Chandler, Arizona, October 13, 2026: Rogers Corporation will announce third quarter 2026 results after market close on October 27, 2026.
body_markdown:
##### Release Date: 10/13/2026


Chandler, Arizona, October 13, 2026: Rogers Corporation (NYSE: ROG) (“Rogers”) will announce third quarter 2026 results after market close on October 27, 2026. The company will hold a conference call at 5:00 pm ET to discuss the results. The call will be hosted by Ali El-Haj, President and Chief Executive Officer, who will be joined by Laura Russell, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.


A live webcast of the call and the accompanying presentation will be available on Rogers’ Investor Relations website at https://www.rogerscorp.com/investors. A webcast replay will be available on the same website following the call.


### About Rogers Corporation


Rogers Corporation (NYSE: ROG) is a global leader in engineered materials to power, protect and connect our world. Rogers delivers innovative solutions to help our customers solve their toughest material challenges. Rogers’ advanced electronic and elastomeric materials are used in applications for EV/HEV, automotive safety and radar systems, mobile devices, renewable energy, wireless infrastructure, energy-efficient motor drives, industrial equipment and more. Headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Rogers operates manufacturing facilities in the United States, Asia and Europe, with sales offices worldwide.
